messages: Olivia (PM): Quick design check — the new spend header on /usage feels visually heavy when a workspace has lots of projects. Ping @Raj for layout thoughts. Raj (Design): I agree. Current stack uses two dense rows (summary + token breakdown). Proposal: collapse token breakdown into an expandable row to reduce vertical noise. Maria (Frontend): collapsing is fine but we should avoid a11y traps. Expanding many rows could bloat the DOM. We can virtualize collapsed content but need a clear affordance. Emily (Accessibility): Contrast issue on the tiny token chips — color ratio falls below AA at small sizes. Also missing focus ring for keyboard users on the collapse chevrons. Sam (Eng): From infra side, collapsing by default is cheap. Concern: if we collapse and users expect the sparkline/mini-graph inline, they might miss trends. Maybe show a micro-sparkline only for top-level view and full chart inside expanded. Olivia (PM): Good call. So compact header + micro-sparkline in the row, and the token breakdown (per-model tokens + invoice CTA) inside the expanded panel. Thoughts on where the invoice download button should live? Raj (Design): Right-aligning invoice CTA on the row makes it obvious, but it competes with the project actions (three-dot). Alternative: keep download in the expanded panel and add a subtle right-aligned quick-download icon when invoice is available. That balances discoverability vs misclicks. Emily (Accessibility): If we add a quick-download icon, ensure aria-label includes invoice month and size, e.g., "Download invoice — March 2026, 2.3MB". Also ensure the icon is keyboard reachable. Maria (Frontend): Implementation note: small icon is fine, but we need to debounce the hover tooltip and avoid fetching invoice metadata on list render. We'll lazy-load metadata when a row is focused or hovered for >200ms. Sam (Eng): Backend: we can surface invoice presence via the existing billing summary endpoint (adds one bool + url). No heavy lift. Lazy fetch on hover sounds fine. DesignBot: Automated lint: component "spend-row" missing aria-expanded attribute on collapse button. Recommend: ``` Sam (Eng): That markup looks good. We'll add server-side flag for invoice availability and a small telemetry event when users click quick-download to measure discoverability. Olivia (PM): Decision for sprint: 1) Try compact header with micro-sparkline + collapsed token breakdown by default, 2) Add quick-download icon (right aligned) but keep full invoice inside expanded panel, 3) Update copy to "API tokens consumed (30d)", 4) Ensure focus states and contrast meet AA. Raj/Maria to ship Figma + CSS spec by EOD Friday. Engineering to estimate implementation cost. Raj (Design): Will post updated frames and a short before/after gif here when ready. Emily (Accessibility): I'll do a quick audit after the implementation and leave a small checklist for QA. Olivia (PM): Thanks all :thumbsup:
